text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital with yet another emphatic 
win!! Just how many G1 titles does she 
have now?!

Agnes Digital won and won and kept on 
winning at every single racetrack.

Her fame echoed throughout the entire 
town—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Man, I am just on absolute top form, 
aren't I? Winning this much is crazy.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, just walking around town, 
people call me by that... utterly 
'fabulous' title...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's Agnes Digital!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: All hail the King of the Mile!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh? 'Mile King'...? Not 'All-Rounder'?

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's the Mile King! Hey, Mile King—!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hokeke?! What kind of parallel world is 
this?! I'm an all-rounder...

Curious, I decided to head to the library 
to look up the race records.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, and thank you for coming today. 
Um, according to my research...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"With a record like this, it's no wonder 
people call them the Mile King."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Junior Class Mile GⅠ, Oka Sho, NHK Mile 
Cup, Mile CS, February Stakes, Victoria 
Mile, Yasuda Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
She has won every single one, like never 
before in history. Wouldn't you say she 
truly is the hero of the mile?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Librarian girl... glasses... so good...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh? U-Um...?

I answered in her place. Before anyone 
knew it, she had seemingly conquered all 
the prestigious mile races.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Digitan in a biiiind!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Because up until now, my title has been 
the 'All-Rounder', you know?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Well, while I'm certainly happy to be 
called the 'Mile King', it's totally 
breaking character for me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
If titles overlap, it gets complicated! 
Adam and Eve, top and bottom, the 
coexistence of classic detective mysteries 
and B-grade horror!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"As I thought, I'll have to give up on one 
of them. This is all to protect my 
identity. Mmmgh..."
Agnes Digital agonizes over it. Just then—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ah, there you are, King of the Mile!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Flower, look, it's Digital! She's been 
winning like crazy lately..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital-san, I always watch your 
races. Um...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, would you please spar 
with me in the future? I have so much 
respect for you...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'll gladly lend it to you! Not just a 
sparring partner—I'm all yours!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Who would have thought there'd be such a 
byproduct! The new title has drawn in 
Umamusume whom I rarely had the chance to 
interact with before...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
In that case—breaking character is fully 
permitted! In fact, breaking character is 
encouraged!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, I forgot! I'm— an all-rounder! 
Right?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Which means I can collect as many titles 
as I want. No matter how many Umamusume I 
get involved with, it's all good.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I've decided! Digitan is going to 
live her life as an "All-Rounder and Mile 
Queen"!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
We'll take all comers! At this rate, let's 
conquer every single distance!

Agnes Digital is not merely versatile. She 
brilliantly proved herself to be a 
speedster for the history books.
